title: Data consultant brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.
Who we are
At Artefact Lat Am, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!
A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.
Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.
We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!What you will be doing
As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.
Innovate:You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
Learn and Share:You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations:You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
Act Across the Project Value Chain:From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
Participate in Training:You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team:You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.
What we are looking for
Academic Background:In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.What We Offer:
Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
Gympass

Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)Why you should join us
Artefact is the place to be:come and build the future of marketing
Progress:every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
Culture:join the best team you could ever imagine
Entrepreneurship:you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!Come join us!

title: Account manager
description:
LOVE startups and always dreamed of working in tech?
WANT to become a disrupter, tackling one of the world’s biggest problems?
BELIEVE you can use your skills to help change the world?Oneday is a VC-backed Ed Tech company that supports aspiring entrepreneurs from all corners of society to launch their dream business, with expert support from a mentor, a deep curriculum of content, and a vibrant community of business founders.We have raised $20 M+ in funding from the UK's and Silicon Valley's leading VCs. Our launch phase has been extremely successful and we have reached a stage to take the next step in driving further awareness and intent for our growing range of products.We’re looking for Account Managers to join our inbound sales team and own the early-stage founder experience.What you’ll do..
As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for managing warm inbound leads from start to finish:
Conduct high-quality discovery calls with founders who’ve already shown interest
Understand what they’re building, why it matters, and where they’re stuck
Clearly position Oneday’s programs and mentorship
Confidently handle objections and guide qualified founders to the next step
Book next-step calls and keep your pipeline clean and updated
Work in a high-volume environment (150–250 calls/day) while staying sharp
Track your performance and continuously improve conversion ratesThis is not a passive customer success role.
It’s a performance-driven, ownership-heavy sales role where outcomes matter.You’ll likely do well here if you:
Have experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles (startup experience is a big plus)
Are comfortable on the phone and can build rapport quickly
Think in terms of numbers, conversion rates, and improvement
Can stay organised and disciplined in a fast-moving environment
Take feedback well and apply it
Have strong written and spoken English skills
Are resilient, proactive, and take ownership of resultsWhat you’ll get:
Unparalleled experience of working for a hyper-growth startup
Having fun and learning from your more experienced colleagues — serial entrepreneurs, investors and engineers
Fully remote working environment
Fantastic opportunity to get to know hundreds of founders and executives in the world on a first name basis

title: Brazil packaging salesperson, remote
description:

Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.Role DescriptionWe are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.ResponsibilitiesThe successful candidate will be responsible for:- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands
- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil’s cosmetic packaging market
- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements
- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting
- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

title: Video editor
description:
We are…
A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.You Are...
An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team
You Will...
Edit audio and video for podcast, You Tube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, You Tube, Tik Tok).
Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
and more...Job Requirements
You Have...
The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados.
Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.Necessário:Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Pessoa cientista de dados - vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar.Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver.Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
Atuarem toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
Popularizartermos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
Priorizarsuas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas
O que nós estamos procurando:
Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Desejávelum primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
Curiosidade:você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovaçõesO que oferecemos:VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)
Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!Junte-se a nós!

title: Wordpress plugin & full stack developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.Responsibilities
Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
Test Planning and Execution:Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality.
Defect Management:Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
Collaboration:Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality.
Automation:Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks.
Quality Standards:Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company.Qualifications
Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
Deadline and detail-oriented
Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.Compensation

A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.
Quem somos:
Nós da Artefact Lat Am acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!
Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.
Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.
Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!
Quais serão suas responsabilidades:Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.
Inovar. Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
Aprender e Compartilhar.Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
Desenvolver.Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
Atuarem toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
Popularizartermos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
Priorizarsuas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas
O que nós estamos procurando:
Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.
Desejávelum primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
Curiosidade:você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovaçõesO que oferecemos:VR/VT
Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
Gympass
Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)
Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!Junte-se a nós!

title: Python/cloud platform developer
description:
Python/Cloud Platform DeveloperImportant Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob SummaryWe seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.Responsibilities and DutiesDevelop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5 G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.Essential SkillsSolid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
How to work on the command line and with files;
How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
How to create and run simple scripts;
Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
Experience with Docker;
Experience with Helm.Highly Desirable SkillsExperience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
Experience with Postgre SQL as a developer;
Experience with Rabbit MQ as a developer.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

title: Devops engineer sr
description:
Dev Ops Engineer SRImportant Information
Location:Brazil
Job Mode:Full-time
Work Mode:Work from homeJob SummaryThis is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.
You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.Responsibilities and DutiesManage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, Cloud Front, and WAF;
Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS Cloud Formation;
Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using Circle CI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.Essential SkillsExpertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, Cloud Front, and WAF;
Strong experience with Cloud Formation for managing AWS infrastructure;
Hands-on experience with Circle CI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.Highly Desirable SkillsHands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora My SQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, Dev Sec Ops, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Graphic designer
description:
Company DescriptionEMP is a media and technology company building audience-driven brands across digital media, content, and now Saa S products.
We started as a digital media group with a fan-first mindset and have grown into a company that blends content, distribution, and technology. Today, we are expanding beyond media into software products that support creators, brands, and audiences. That means design work here goes beyond social graphics and videos. It increasingly touches product thinking, UX/UI, and how software is presented to users.
We move fast, test often, and care about clean execution. Collaboration matters, but so does ownership. If you like building things that ship and actually get used, you will fit in well here.You AreAn experienced graphic designer who can execute high-quality visual work across media and digital products. You are comfortable working in fast-moving environments, collaborating with editors, marketers, and product-minded teammates. You care about clarity, usability, and aesthetics, not just making things look cool.
You are also curious about software and product design, and you are interested in expanding your skill set into UX/UI and Saa S-oriented design work.Role Description This is a full-time, remote role for a Graphic Designer.
You will create visual assets across our media brands, including graphics, branding elements, and design systems for social, web, and video. You will also support our growing Saa S initiatives by contributing to UX/UI design, product mockups, and software framing using tools like Figma.
Your work will sit at the intersection of content, marketing, and product. You will help translate ideas into clean visuals, clear user flows, and consistent brand experiences across platforms.
Day-to-day responsibilities include concepting, designing, iterating based on feedback, and collaborating with media, marketing, and product stakeholders.ResponsibilitiesDesign graphics, branding assets, and visual systems for digital media platforms
Support video and social content with strong visual design
Contribute to UX/UI design for Saa S and internal software products
Create wireframes, mockups, and product flows using Figma
Maintain brand consistency across media, web, and product surfaces
Collaborate with marketing, content, and product teams
Iterate quickly and incorporate feedback without frictionQualificationsStrong foundation in graphic design and visual communication
Experience with branding, logo design, and typography
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite
Working knowledge of Figma and interest in UX/UI or product design
Attention to detail and strong design judgment
Clear communication skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup
Experience in digital media, marketing, or tech is a plus
Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or equivalent experience
Fluent in English, written and spoken

description:

Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.

3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.What we offer:
Competitive salary and benefits.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A collaborative and innovative work environment.
The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.

title: Mainframe automation engineer (zos) - home office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking aSenior Mainframe Automation Engineer (z OS Automation and CA OPS/MVS)to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).We are seeking an experiencedSenior Mainframe Automation Engineerto lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning fromCA OPS/MVStoIBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OSand fromCA Automation PointtoIBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM). The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position doesnot impact application developmentbut will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.Job responsibilities :
Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.Key skills :
Mainframe Operations Expertise:Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS:Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
TSO and ISPF:Proficient in using these tools for system management.
JCL:Strong skills in Job Control Language.
REXX Programming:Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
System Automation Policy Database (PDB):Working knowledge required.
Migration Experience:Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
Net View for z/OS:Experience in implementing and using this product.Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:
Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Starrocks database engineer (dbe) - remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support
Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)
Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support
Reports to:CTO / VP EngineeringAboutDeep. BI
We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, Star Rocks and other emerging technologies. Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.Role Overview
As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting Star Rocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of Dev Ops, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.Key Responsibilities
Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4):Diagnose and resolve complex issues in Star Rocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
Performance optimization:Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
Architecture & design support:Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA:Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
CVE patching:Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
Knowledge sharing:Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
Optional / nice-to-have:
Support deployments with Dev Ops engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.Requirements
2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting Star Rocks clusters in larger scale production(not just querying or dashboard usage; no Po Cs)
Proven experience withquery optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines.
Solid knowledge ofdistributed systems concepts(consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
Hands-on experience withhigh availability and disaster recovery setups
Comfort withLinux systems, networking basics and SQL.
Ability toanalyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure(incident scenarios)
Strong English language communication skills— able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
Bonus:Experience with Apache Druid, Click House, Ti DB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.What we offer
Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies atenterprise scale.
Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
Competitive salary
Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2 B), depending on your location and preference.Location & working style
Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Cro & shopify developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer
Full time contractor
£22-32k per year (depending on experience).
Bonus structure on performanceAbout PM Digital
PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.About the Role
We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.
This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.What You'll Do
Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on itWhat We're Looking For
3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
Strong HTML, CSS, Java Script — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
Strong AI Use case to speed up time to deliveryWhat Success Looks Like
Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holdingYou'll Thrive Here If You:
Want ownership, not tickets
Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
Move fast and communicate clearly
Take pride in clean, maintainable work
Want to grow with a high-performance teamYou Won't Thrive Here If You:
Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
See QA as someone else's problem
Struggle with direct feedback
Don't hit deadlinesDetails
Remote (European time zone based)
Full-time contractor
Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOEHow to Apply
Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:
Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

title: Video editor
description:
About Made Simpler
Made Simpler exists toempower small and medium-sized businesses to growsmarter, stronger, and with real impact. We believe opportunity should not be defined by company size or available resources. With the right system in place, any business can compete, scale, and lead.
We are the world’s firstWholesale Marketing Agency , delivering Managed Marketing as a Service (MMaa S), a powerful combination of strategic human expertise and AI acceleration. Our model provides accessible, scalable, and results-driven marketing and revenue engines, leveling the playing field for growing businesses.
About the role
We are looking for aVideo Editor with strong experience in Artificial Intelligence tools , capable of creating highly persuasive videos for Social Media, Ads, and institutional content.
This role requires the ability to balance human storytelling with AI efficiency, producing high-quality, scalable, and performance-driven video content.
This is a full time opportunity, 100% remote.
Key Responsibilities
Video editing and assembly: transform raw footage into polished, engaging, and cohesive narratives across multiple platforms, including social media, websites, and advertising.
Mastery of video editing tools: work with professional editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Da Vinci Resolve, and Cap Cut Pro (or similar).
AI-powered video creation: leverage generative AI platforms to create avatars, videos, and unique visual assets, with a strong focus on tools like Creatify AI.
Asset organization and management: maintain efficient organization of files, versions, and workflows using tools such as Notion and Google Drive.
Platform optimization: adapt formats, aspect ratios, codecs, and audio levels to maximize performance across platforms like Instagram, Tik Tok, You Tube, and paid ads.
Must haves
Proficiency in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Da Vinci Resolve, or Cap Cut Pro.
Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to video creation and post-production, such as Midjourney, Creatify AI, Nano Banana, Kling 3.0, Google Flow, etc.
Strong storytelling ability, with a solid grasp of pacing, persuasion, and visual composition.
Technical knowledge of video formats, codecs, compression, color correction/grading, sound design, and motion graphics.
Intermediate to advanced English

title: Application support - dynatrace (relocation to portugal)

title: Cro & shopify developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer
Full time contractor
£22-32k per year (depending on experience).
Bonus structure on performanceAbout PM Digital
PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.About the Role
We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.
This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.What You'll Do
Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on itWhat We're Looking For
3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
Strong HTML, CSS, Java Script — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
Strong AI Use case to speed up time to deliveryWhat Success Looks Like
Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holdingYou'll Thrive Here If You:
Want ownership, not tickets
Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
Move fast and communicate clearly
Take pride in clean, maintainable work
Want to grow with a high-performance teamYou Won't Thrive Here If You:
Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
See QA as someone else's problem
Struggle with direct feedback
Don't hit deadlinesDetails
Remote (European time zone based)
Full-time contractor
Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOEHow to Apply
Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:
Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

title: Cro & shopify developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer
Full time contractor
£22-32k per year (depending on experience).
Bonus structure on performanceAbout PM Digital
PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.About the Role
We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.
This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.What You'll Do
Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on itWhat We're Looking For
3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
Strong HTML, CSS, Java Script — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
Strong AI Use case to speed up time to deliveryWhat Success Looks Like
Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holdingYou'll Thrive Here If You:
Want ownership, not tickets
Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
Move fast and communicate clearly
Take pride in clean, maintainable work
Want to grow with a high-performance teamYou Won't Thrive Here If You:
Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
See QA as someone else's problem
Struggle with direct feedback
Don't hit deadlinesDetails
Remote (European time zone based)
Full-time contractor
Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOEHow to Apply
Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:
Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

title: Data scientist - catálogo
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: aCentauro ,maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina , e aFisia ,distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar nasquad de Catálogo , com foco em qualidade, enriquecimento e padronização de dados de produtos, utilizando técnicas de Inteligência artificial.
Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução do catálogo como ativo central do negócio, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia, Design e Negócio.Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e evoluir soluções baseadas em IA e Machine Learning para enriquecimento automático de produtos, como:
Padronização de descrições e títulos
Inferência e sugestão de atributos
Classificação e reclassificação de produtosAtuar na definição e otimização de:
Modelos e regras de categorização de produtos
Estratégias de enriquecimento e validação automática de atributos
Métricas de qualidade de catálogo (completude, consistência, acurácia e unicidade)Trabalhar com modelos supervisionados e não supervisionados, incluindo abordagens baseadas em NLP e LLMs, quando aplicável.
Avaliar e evoluir métricas que conectem qualidade de catálogo com impacto em negócio e experiência do usuário (ex: conversão, busca, recomendação).
Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar o impacto das melhorias de enriquecimento e qualidade do catálogo.
Traduzir problemas de negócio e operacionais em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados escaláveis.
Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto e áreas de negócio na definição do roadmap técnico de catálogo.
Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento das soluções baseadas em IA.
Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas e decisões analíticas.Requisitos necessários:
Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins.
Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
Experiência prática com problemas de classificação, enriquecimento ou qualidade de dados.
Forte domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados.
Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem.
Experiência com modelos de machine learning aplicados a dados estruturados.
Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto digital.
Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex: Big Query, data lakes).
Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume e complexidade de dados.
Noções de MLOps.
Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais:
Experiência prévia com catálogo de produtos, e-commerce ou marketplace.
Conhecimento em modelagem de dados e governança de dados.
Vivência com detecção de anomalias e métricas de qualidade de dados.
Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre sistemas.
Conhecimento em NLP aplicado a dados de produtos (ex: normalização de descrições, extração de atributos).
Conhecimento em visualização de dados e storytelling analítico.
Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado:
Forte mentalidade de qualidade de dados como produto.
Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto de negócio.
Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta.
Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados.
Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.#Seleção SBF #vempra SBF

title: Support specialist
description:
At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!About the opportunity
As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.
﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?Key Responsibilities:Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
Customer Support
Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
Documentation & Reporting
Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
Escalation Management
Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise:
Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, mac OS, Linux) and common software applications.
Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
Problem-solving Ability:
An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
Organizational Skills:
Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, i OS).
Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
Previous work with an American company
Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern Saa S platforms.Who You Are:
A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
Passion for helping others internally and externally
Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
In addition, we give bonus points for having a Saa S or Ecommerce background!

title: Senior business/system analyst (disaster recovery)
description:
Product Overview:
Vuori is re-defining what athletic apparel looks like: built to move and sweat in but designed with a casual aesthetic to transition into everyday life. Our high-energy, fast-paced office environment is reflected in the clothes we make. We aim to inspire others to take on all aspects of their lives with clarity, enthusiasm, and purpose…. while having a lot of fun along the way. We are proud to be an outlet for the opportunity of personal growth and success.Overview
We are seeking a contract Business Analyst to support the development and execution of our Disaster Recovery (DR) Program. This role will help establish structure, documentation, and repeatable processes to ensure our DR efforts are organized, testable, and aligned with business needs.Key Responsibilities
Develop the overall structure and framework for the Disaster Recovery Program, including roles, responsibilities, and governance.
Create and refine documentation such as DR runbooks, process flows, and system recovery procedures.
Partner with technical teams to capture system dependencies, failover steps, testing requirements, and validation criteria.
Build templates, standards, and repeatable processes to drive consistency across DR documentation.
Coordinate project tasks, track progress, and support cross-functional alignment to ensure milestones are met.
Facilitate workshops and gather requirements from subject-matter experts.
Define DR test planning, evidence capture, post-test reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
Ensure documentation aligns with internal standards and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC2).Required Qualifications
5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Program Coordinator, or similar role.
Experience supporting Disaster Recovery, Business Continuity, or technology resilience programs.

title: Médico endocrinologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"
Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas emEndocrinologia!Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade emEndocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:Fornecer atendimento médico especializado emEndocrinologiade forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbiosEndocrinológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade emEndocrinologiae critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doençasEndocrinológicas.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde emEndocrinologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica:
Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
